description_en: Retrieves the parameter settings of a gateway
name: GetGatewayConfig

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the gateway
parameters.name: gateway_unique_id

parameters.help_en: The language in which the returned results are displayed. Valid values: zh (default): Chinese, en: English
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果显示的语言。取值：zh（默认值）：中文，en：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

Code.description_en: The code is used only to synchronize with the success status

DownstreamConnectionBufferLimits.description_en: The buffer size for a single connection. Configuring this parameter affects the throughput and memory usage of the gateway. Unit: bytes. This parameter applies to gateway connections
DownstreamConnectionBufferLimits.description_zh: 作用于网关连接，单条链接的buffer大小，配置后会影响吞吐和网关的内存使用（单位：Byte）

DownstreamHttp2MaxConcurrentStream.description_en: The maximum number of concurrent streams on a single connection when the client uses HTTP/2. This parameter applies to the request phase
DownstreamHttp2MaxConcurrentStream.description_zh: 作用于请求环节，客户端使用http2时一条链接上最大并发数

DownstreamIdleTime.description_en: The idle timeout period for the connection between the client and the gateway. If no request is received within the specified period, the connection is closed. This parameter applies to gateway connections
DownstreamIdleTime.description_zh: 作用于网关连接，客户端到网关处于指定的时间内没有请求，则会断开链接
DownstreamIdleTime.title_en: 客户端到网关处于指定的时间内[0-600]没有请求，则会断开链接
DownstreamIdleTime.title_zh: 客户端到网关处于指定的时间内[0-600]没有请求，则会断开链接

EnableCustomAuthConfigPush.description_en: Specifies whether to enable custom authentication configuration push. This parameter applies to scenarios where a self-managed authentication service is used. If enabled, changes to authentication rules do not cause connection interruptions. This feature is suitable for WebSocket and online business scenarios
EnableCustomAuthConfigPush.description_zh: 作用于使用自建的鉴权服务的场景，开启后鉴权规则变更不会引起连接中断，适用于WebSocket和在线业务场景

EnableGenerateRequestId.description_en: Specifies whether to generate a request ID in the request header based on the configuration to trace the request. This parameter applies to the request scope
EnableGenerateRequestId.description_zh: 作用于请求范围，根据配置会在请求头中生成requestId，以便追踪请求

EnableGzip.description_en: Specifies whether to enable Gzip compression for requests and responses. Enabling Gzip compression reduces gateway traffic but increases gateway CPU consumption. This parameter applies to the request and response phases
EnableGzip.description_zh: 作用于请求与响应环节，启用gzip会对请求响应进行压缩，会减少网关流量，增加网关cpu消耗

EnableGzipHardwareAccelerate.description_en: Specifies whether to enable Gzip hardware acceleration
EnableGzipHardwareAccelerate.description_zh: 是否启用 Gzip 硬件加速

EnableHardwareAccelerate.description_en: Specifies whether to enable hardware acceleration. If the region does not support hardware acceleration at the underlying layer, or if hardware acceleration was not specified during purchase, the configuration fails to take effect
EnableHardwareAccelerate.description_zh: 是否开启硬件加速(若您的地域处于底层不支持地域，或购买时未指定硬件加速会生效失败)
EnableHardwareAccelerate.title_en: 是否开启硬件加速(若您的地域处于底层不支持地域，或购买时未指定硬件加速会生效失败)
EnableHardwareAccelerate.title_zh: 是否开启硬件加速(若您的地域处于底层不支持地域，或购买时未指定硬件加速会生效失败)

EnableHttp2.description_en: Specifies whether to use HTTP/2 during negotiation between the server and the client. Changes take effect after 1 to 2 minutes. This parameter applies to the request phase
EnableHttp2.description_zh: 作用于请求环节，服务端与客户端协商时是否使用http2（修改后1～2分钟后生效）

EnableHttp3.description_en: Indicates whether the HTTP/3 protocol is supported

EnableK8sSourceWorkloadFilter.description_en: The tag filtering configuration for Kubernetes service source workloads
EnableK8sSourceWorkloadFilter.description_zh: Kubernetes 服务来源工作负载的标签过滤配置

Enable.description_en: Specifies whether to enable tag filtering for Kubernetes service source workloads
Enable.description_zh: 是否启用 Kubernetes 服务来源工作负载的标签过滤

FilterOpt.description_en: The tag filtering method. EQUAL indicates matching the specified tag. NOT_EQUAL indicates excluding the specified tag
FilterOpt.description_zh: 标签过滤方式。EQUAL 表示匹配指定标签，NOT_EQUAL 表示排除指定标签

LabelKey.description_en: The tag key used to filter Kubernetes workloads
LabelKey.description_zh: 用于筛选 Kubernetes 工作负载的标签键

LabelValue.description_en: The tag value used to filter Kubernetes workloads
LabelValue.description_zh: 用于筛选 Kubernetes 工作负载的标签值

EnableProxyProtocol.description_en: Specifies whether to enable the PROXY protocol. If the gateway ingress traffic is connected through a Network Load Balancer (NLB) and this feature is disabled, the real IP address of the client cannot be obtained. Enabling this feature does not affect non-PROXY protocol requests
EnableProxyProtocol.description_zh: 是否开启Proxy协议，如果网关入口流量使用NLB接入，如果不开启则无法获取客户端的真实IP，开启后对于非Proxy协议请求没有影响

EnableSlashMerge.description_en: Specifies whether to merge consecutive slashes in a request. If enabled, extra slashes in a URL such as www.a.com//b are merged and treated as www.a.com/b. This parameter applies to the request phase
EnableSlashMerge.description_zh: 作用于请求环节，是否合并请求中多余的‘/’, 开启后www.a.com//b多余的'/'会被合并，将会同www.a.com/b一致
EnableSlashMerge.title_en: 是否合并‘/’, 开启后www.a.com//b多余的'/'会被合并，将会同www.a.com/b一致
EnableSlashMerge.title_zh: 是否合并‘/’, 开启后www.a.com//b多余的'/'会被合并，将会同www.a.com/b一致

EnableXffTrustedCidrs.description_en: The trusted X-Forwarded-For source CIDR block configuration
EnableXffTrustedCidrs.description_zh: 可信 X-Forwarded-For 来源地址段配置

Enable.description_en: Specifies whether to enable the trusted X-Forwarded-For source CIDR block configuration
Enable.description_zh: 是否启用可信 X-Forwarded-For 来源地址段配置

IpListContent.description_en: The list of trusted source IP addresses or CIDR blocks
IpListContent.description_zh: 可信来源 IP 地址或 CIDR 地址段列表

GatewayUniqueId.description_en: The unique ID of the gateway

InitialConnectionWindowSize.description_en: The initial connection-level window size negotiated between the gateway and the client when HTTP/2 is used. Unit: bytes. This parameter applies to the request phase
InitialConnectionWindowSize.description_zh: 作用于请求环节，网关同客户端使用http2时连接级别初始窗口大小（单位：Byte）
InitialConnectionWindowSize.title_en: http2  连接 初始窗口大小
InitialConnectionWindowSize.title_zh: http2  连接 初始窗口大小

InitialStreamWindowSize.description_en: The initial stream window size negotiated between the gateway and the client when HTTP/2 is used. Unit: bytes. This parameter applies to the request phase
InitialStreamWindowSize.description_zh: 作用于请求环节，网关同客户端使用http2时协商的stream初始窗口大小（单位：Byte）
InitialStreamWindowSize.title_en: http2  stream 初始窗口大小
InitialStreamWindowSize.title_zh: http2  stream 初始窗口大小

KeepaliveHeaderTimeout.description_en: The timeout period used to generate the Keep-Alive response header returned to the client, which indicates the keep-alive time of the connection. For example, if this parameter is set to 10, the `keep-alive: timeout=10` response header is returned. If this parameter is set to 0, the response header is not returned
KeepaliveHeaderTimeout.description_zh: 用于生成Keep-Alive响应头返回给客户端，告知连接的保活时间。例如配置为10时，会返回响应头: `keep-alive: timeout=10`。配置为0时，不会返回该响应头

LiteMetrics.description_en: Indicates whether lightweight metric collection is enabled
LiteMetrics.description_zh: 是否启用轻量级指标采集

LogRequestResponseConfig.description_en: The log collection configuration for request and response headers and bodies. The content is a JSON string
LogRequestResponseConfig.description_zh: 请求和响应的 Header、Body 日志采集配置，内容为 JSON 字符串

PathWithEscapedSlashes.description_en:
The action to take when a URI path contains escaped slashes such as %2F, %2f, %5C, or %5c. Default value: KEEP_UNCHANGED. Valid values:
KEEP_UNCHANGED
REJECT_REQUEST
UNESCAPE_AND_REDIRECT
UNESCAPE_AND_FORWARD
PathWithEscapedSlashes.description_zh:
确定 URI 路径中包含 %2F、%2f、%5C 或 %5c 这些转义的请求的操作, 默认为KEEP_UNCHANGED(保持不变)

取值：

KEEP_UNCHANGED

REJECT_REQUEST

UNESCAPE_AND_REDIRECT

UNESCAPE_AND_FORWARD

PreserveExternalRequestID.description_en: Specifies whether to retain the request ID passed by the client
PreserveExternalRequestID.description_zh: 是否保留客户端传入的 Request ID

PreserveHeaderFormat.description_en: Specifies whether to preserve the original case of request headers. In the HTTP/1.1 specification, headers are case-insensitive. To ensure compatibility with the HTTP/2 specification, headers are converted to lowercase by default. This parameter applies to the request and response phases
PreserveHeaderFormat.description_zh: 作用于请求和响应环节，是否保持请求header头大小写, http1.1规范中 header头不区分大小写进行识别，为了保证与http2规范兼容，默认会统一转化为小写
PreserveHeaderFormat.title_en: 是否保持header头大小写, http1.1规范中 header头不区分大小写进行识别，为了保证与http2规范兼容，默认会统一转化为小写
PreserveHeaderFormat.title_zh: 是否保持header头大小写, http1.1规范中 header头不区分大小写进行识别，为了保证与http2规范兼容，默认会统一转化为小写

GatewayUniqueId.description_en: The unique ID of the gateway

LogOn.description_en: Specifies whether log delivery is enabled

LogStoreName.description_en:
The destination Logstore for log delivery. Valid values:
mse_gw_access_log: Nginx Ingress compatibility is disabled.
nginx-ingress: Nginx Ingress compatibility is enabled
LogStoreName.description_zh:
日志投递目标Logstore，取值：

未开启兼容Nginx Ingress：mse_gw_access_log

开启兼容Nginx Ingress：nginx-ingress

NginxCompatible.description_en: Specifies whether Nginx Ingress compatibility is enabled
NginxCompatible.description_zh: 是否开启兼容 Nginx Ingress

ProjectName.description_en: The destination Simple Log Service project for log delivery

SupportWaf.description_en: Indicates whether the gateway supports Web Application Firewall (WAF)

UpstreamIdleTimeout.description_en: The default idle timeout period for upstream connections

WebsocketTermGracePeriod.description_en: The keep-alive time maintained for WebSocket connections when connections need to be closed during gateway instance upgrades or restarts. Unit: seconds
WebsocketTermGracePeriod.description_zh: 当网关实例升级、重启等需要关闭连接的场景下，为Websocket连接维持的保活时间（单位：s）

XffTrustedNum.description_en: The number of trusted proxies before the gateway. This parameter determines whether the gateway uses request headers such as X-Forwarded-For and X-Request-Id generated by the client. This parameter applies to the request phase
XffTrustedNum.description_zh: 作用于请求环节，网关前可信任的代理个数，会影响网关是否会使用客户端产生的x-forwarded-for和x-request-id等请求头
XffTrustedNum.title_en: 网关前可信任的设备个数
XffTrustedNum.title_zh: 网关前可信任的设备个数

GatewayUniqueId.description_en: The unique ID of the gateway

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the Tracing Analysis information was created
GmtCreate.description_zh: 链路追踪信息创建时间

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the Tracing Analysis information was modified
GmtModified.description_zh: 链路追踪信息修改时间

Id.description_en: The ID of the Tracing Analysis information

ServiceId.description_en: The SkyWalking service ID for self-managed SkyWalking

ServicePort.description_en: The SkyWalking service port for self-managed SkyWalking

TraceOn.description_en: Specifies whether Tracing Analysis is enabled

TraceType.description_en:
The Tracing Analysis type. Valid values:
XTRACE: Managed Service for OpenTelemetry with the Zipkin protocol.
SKYWALKING: Self-managed SkyWalking.
OPENTELEMETRY: Managed Service for OpenTelemetry with the OpenTelemetry protocol.
OTSKYWALKING: Managed Service for OpenTelemetry with the SkyWalking protocol
TraceType.description_zh:
链路追踪类型：

XTRACE：可观测链路OpenTelemetry版，链路追踪协议Zipkin

SKYWALKING：自建Skywalking

OPENTELEMETRY：可观测链路OpenTelemetry版，链路追踪协议OpenTelemetry

OTSKYWALKING：可观测链路OpenTelemetry版，链路追踪协议Skywalking

ZipAlgorithm.description_en: The compression algorithm used when compression is enabled. You can select brotli or gzip. If EnableGzip is not enabled, the EnableGzip option is automatically enabled
ZipAlgorithm.description_zh: 开启压缩后使用的算法，可以选择brotli，gzip，如果此时EnableGzip未开启，将自动开启EnableGzip选项

DynamicCode.description_en: This parameter is not used. Ignore it
DynamicCode.title_en: 动态错误信息中的占位符
DynamicCode.title_zh: 动态错误信息中的占位符

DynamicMessage.description_en: This parameter is not used. Ignore it

Success.description_en:
The request result. Valid values:
`true`: The request is successful.
`false`: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求结果，取值如下：
`true`：请求成功。
`false`：请求失败
